'''Formos Spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|space port]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Formos/Legends|Formos]].

==History==
[[File:Prisonbreak_on_formos.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] escapes a [[Imperial prison barge]] by a nearby crane, with his rival, [[Hronk]], in tow.]]

The [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] was used by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] to take on board [[Spice/Legends|spice]] shipments from nearby [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] as well as [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] troops to round up criminals and transport them to the spice mines on Kessel. The spaceport had enough landing space for [[Imperial prison barge]]s like [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Quirt's prison ship|Quirt's]] and the loading docks were equipped with large cranes.

When [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] visited the world on a smuggling run, they landed in the spaceport and were caught up in several incidents that nearly cost them their freedom. In the end, the pair escaped Imperial pursuit, but had to drop their cargo of spice in the process. The spaceport had [[Zord's Atmosphere Baths]] as one of its few attractions.
